safety_notice: ALL IDENTITIES, NUMBERS, NAMES, DATES, ADDRESSES, AND PORTRAITS IN THIS DATASET ARE 100% SYNTHETIC AND FICTIONAL. NO REAL PII IS PRESENT.

documents.title: Clean International Passport
documents.description: Standard authentic-style ICAO 9303 compliant synthetic passport with crisp OCR and matching MRZ check digits.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: High confidence OCR on visual inspection zone
expected_pipeline_behavior.mrz_expected: Valid ICAO 9303 TD3 MRZ with passing check digits

documents.demonstrates: Baseline genuine passport verification with full MRZ checksum validation and visual consistency.

documents.title: Passport with MRZ Check Digit Mismatch
documents.description: Passport with intentional tamper in MRZ check digit (Z84920159 instead of Z84920156) simulating altered identity number.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: High confidence OCR on visual inspection zone
expected_pipeline_behavior.mrz_expected: MRZ checksum failure on document number check digit

documents.demonstrates: Detection of manipulated machine-readable zone checksums.

documents.title: Low Resolution / Degraded Passport
documents.description: Passport captured under poor optical conditions with Gaussian blur and lower DPI, testing OCR robustness and evidence confidence degradation.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Degraded OCR confidence due to optical blur
expected_pipeline_behavior.mrz_expected: May have read errors or low character confidence

documents.demonstrates: Evidence confidence scoring and adaptive step-up requests triggered by image degradation.

documents.title: Clean Aadhaar-Style ID Card
documents.description: Synthetic national ID card with 12-digit UIDAI-pattern number, barcode, and clean text layout. MRZ is not applicable.

synthetic_identity.name: PRIYA RAJESH PATEL
synthetic_identity.address: 402, Lotus Enclave, MG Road, Pune, Maharashtra - 411001

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Clean extraction of 12-digit ID, DOB, Name, and Address

documents.demonstrates: Document-type awareness where non-MRZ documents correctly bypass MRZ penalties while verifying visual fields.

documents.title: Aadhaar with Name/DOB Anomaly
documents.description: Aadhaar card with mismatched formatting, unformatted ID number (9182374650199 13 digits) and inconsistent DOB format.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Extraction reveals 13-digit non-standard ID and formatting inconsistencies

documents.demonstrates: Visual field validation and format conformance checks on national ID documents.

documents.title: Blurred Aadhaar-Style ID Card
documents.description: Aadhaar card with motion blur simulating poor camera capture on mobile onboarding.

synthetic_identity.name: PRIYA RAJESH PATEL
synthetic_identity.address: 402, Lotus Enclave, MG Road, Pune, Maharashtra - 411001

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Reduced OCR extraction accuracy due to blur

documents.demonstrates: Adaptive verification engine triggering document re-capture request due to poor image quality.

documents.title: Valid Synthetic Driving Licence
documents.description: Standard synthetic driving licence with valid future expiry date (2034-03-14), vehicle classes (MCWG, LMV), and clean OCR fields.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Extraction of licence number, vehicle classes, DOB, and valid expiry date

documents.demonstrates: Genuine driving licence verification with validity checking and non-MRZ handling.

documents.title: Expired Synthetic Driving Licence
documents.description: Driving licence with an expired validity date (2021-03-14), testing pipeline document validity date checks.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Clean extraction of expired validity date (2021-03-14)

documents.demonstrates: Automated detection of expired credentials resulting in fraud/validity risk flags.

documents.title: Tampered Number Driving Licence
documents.description: Driving licence exhibiting visual font discontinuity, spliced number text, and compression artifacts around the ID field.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Discontinuity in font and character metrics

documents.demonstrates: Optical anomaly and document tampering detection on identity credentials.

documents.title: Clean Synthetic Voter ID Card
documents.description: Election commission style synthetic EPIC identity card with 10-character alphanumeric EPIC number (ABC1234567).

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Clean extraction of EPIC number, elector name, relation name, and constituency

documents.demonstrates: Verification of legacy-format election cards without MRZ or machine-readable zones.

documents.title: Voter ID with Altered Details
documents.description: Voter ID card with mismatched EPIC format (ABC1234567X with anomalous extra character) and contradictory father/husband relation text.
documents.demonstrates: Detection of altered alphanumeric identifier strings on voter credentials.

documents.title: Low Contrast Synthetic Voter ID
documents.description: Faded and low-contrast synthetic voter card simulating aged laminated photo identity cards.

expected_pipeline_behavior.ocr_expected: Lower confidence text extraction from faded background

documents.demonstrates: Handling of physical wear, low contrast, and aged document media in adaptive verification.
